reviews.title: Avoid this app

This app has made accessing my university account unnecessarily complicated. I’m stuck in an endless authentication loop: Microsoft Authenticator asks me to sign in, but signing in requires a verification code from Microsoft Authenticator itself.

There is no alternative way to authenticate, and the app provides no useful solution to break this cycle. As a result, I’ve been locked out of my university email, Microsoft 365 applications, and essential academic files for several days.

What’s particularly frustrating is that resolving this issue requires contacting my university’s IT administrator to reset my multi-factor authentication settings. A security application should protect users without making it nearly impossible for legitimate account holders to regain access.

Microsoft seriously needs to improve its account recovery process and provide a reliable alternative when Authenticator stops working.

reviews.text: Genuinely curious why push notifications are so necessary. I have a different authenticator app I would have preferred to use, but I was given no choice but to use Microsoft’s. Fine, okay, yeah, I’ll install a practically pointless app that does the same thing as another app I already have. But then this app also requires me to turn on push notifications! You can’t finish setting up the authentication without allowing notifications!! That’s insane!!! That’s predatory!!! I’m incredibly disappointed and will be deleting this app and the account it is tied to as soon as I am able to. Luckily, I only needed this authenticator for an account I have through an organization. If it was for my personal email I would create a different email address through another company rather than being stuck with this company.

reviews.title: When Corporations Do Things that Nobody Even Asked For
reviews.text: If I could rate this no stars, I would. For the sake of “protection” this app makes it ten times more difficult to sign into your own accounts 🤩 It’s truly a thrilling experience to get a million verification texts when all I want to do is sign into my email. It brings me so much joy to have to redownload and then delete this app from my phone every few months when Microsoft stops remembering who I am. I only have a Microsoft account because my University uses it. What am I emailing that requires me to have to go through this entire ordeal? I could care less if a hacker knew about my invitation to have lunch with the Dean of the Honors College. It’s like using a high security bank vault to protect a moldy ham sandwich. And what’s worse is the Authenticator barely works. It doesn’t even sync up with the computer I’m trying to sign into. That is all. I wish I didn’t have to download this scummy corporate software onto my personal phone. The college should have to pay for it tbh or disable the two step authentication (which is more like a million step authentication. Seriously, when I say I had to sign into six different times on both my phone and my computer, I mean it).
